# Handoff

## Overview

Use this skill when work needs to continue in another turn or by another agent. The handoff should make the next step obvious without rereading the whole conversation.

## Handoff Contents

- Current goal and scope
- Files touched or inspected
- Important decisions and assumptions
- Validation already completed
- Open questions or blockers
- The next concrete action

## Rules

- Keep it compact and actionable.
- Include file references for anything the next agent must inspect.
- Call out anything that would be expensive to rediscover.
- Separate confirmed facts from assumptions.

## Recommended Shape

1. What changed.
2. What is left.
3. What was validated.
4. What the next agent should do first.
